# AGENTS.md

Standalone OpenCode V2 Context & Working-Memory Substrate plugin (`hivemind-substrate`).
Unifies **The Spine** (deterministic JSONL transcript archive, content-addressed `blobs/<sha256>.txt`, OpenCode shadow worktree Git trees, external `tool-output`/`shell` spills, and `.git` commit history), **The Honeycomb** (`.session-archive/index.sqlite` indexing session/delegation lineage, `kv` bindings, trajectory milestones, user prompts, tool calls, file touches, snapshot artifacts, verification receipts, AST code skeletons, PageRank repo maps, and Git temporal co-change matrices), and **Artifacts & Viewports** (step-watermark working-set pruning, 4-tier progressive disclosure recall for Strategist and Implementor viewports, and deterministic compaction continuity).

Read `GLOSSARY.md` before naming anything. Read `.opencode/AGENTS.md` for standing operating posture.

## Agent skills

- **Issue tracker:** Local ticket files under `.planning/phases/<slug>/tickets/` + upstream `shynlee04/hivemind-steward-oc-devin-dev`. See `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md`.
- **Labels:** `ticket` + `phase:<slug>`; no separate triage label vocabulary. See `docs/agents/triage-labels.md`.
- **Domain docs:** Single context; `GLOSSARY.md`, `.planning/architecture/`, `.planning/decisions.tsv`, and `docs/teach-me/`. See `docs/agents/domain.md`.
- **Artifacts:** `.planning/` root (`PROJECT.md`, `ROADMAP.md`, `STATE.md`), phase prefixes `TWM`/`CSG`/`VSC`. See `docs/agents/artifacts.md`.

## Architecture

| File / Module | Owns |
|---|---|
| `src/plugin.ts` | Thin shell: plugin `setup`, tool registration (`substrate.viewport`, `substrate.valve`, `archive.persist`, `ctx.context-prune`), lifecycle hooks (`context`, `compaction`, `tool.execute.after`, `event.subscribe`), option parsing. Imports of `@opencode/plugin` are type-only - the host supplies the runtime module. |
| `src/changes/` | Live project-agnostic change-set & actor trace (`model.ts`, `git.ts`, `host-ledger.ts`, `store.ts`, `trace.ts`): 2-call disclosure (`signal` -> `package` -> `leaf`) over git + host tool ledger with `HEAD`-seeded edit hash-chains, test/build verification `evidence`, and subagent `actors` conclusions. |
| `src/archive/index.ts` | Incremental `persist()` driver: walk up to the root, flatten the tree, write JSONL + `info.json` + blobs + `index.sqlite` gated by `(session_id, max_seq, source_updated_at)` watermarks. |
| `src/archive/source.ts` | `SessionSource` seam + `sqliteSource(dbPath)`: read-only `bun:sqlite` access to `~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db` (`project`, `session_v2`, `session_message`, `kv`). Validates required columns up front; throws `session-archive: host schema drift: <table>.<column> missing`. |
| `src/archive/normalize.ts` | `session_message` rows -> archive records (`user | assistant | skill | shell | context | compaction | boundary | unknown`), blob sinking (including external `tool-output`/`shell` spills and shadow snapshot file blobs), delegation facts, and trajectory milestones. |
| `src/archive/layout.ts` | Archive file layout + lane classification (`root`/`nested`/`external` vs the canonical project root). |
| `src/archive/index-db.ts` | `index.sqlite` DDL, incremental watermark sync, lineage & structural tables (`session`, `delegation`, `milestone`, `file_touch`, `snapshot_artifact`, `verification_receipt`, `provenance_edge`, `working_valve_state`, `code_file`, `code_symbol`, `code_edge`, `git_cochange`). |
| `.opencode/plugins/context-prune.ts` | Prototype working-set valve being unified into `src/` (assistant step watermark, fact breadcrumbs, Do-Not-Reread Working-Memory Manifest). |
| `.opencode/plugins/compaction-continuity.ts` | Prototype compaction continuity prompt contract being unified into `src/` over `index.sqlite`. |
| `test/helpers.ts` | Host DDL copied verbatim from OpenCode (`sqlite3 opencode.db ".schema ..."`), fixture builders. |

## Host contract facts (verified against OpenCode v2.0.32)

- All delegation tools (`subagent`, `delegate-devin`, `hivemind-delegate`) record the child session in `state.metadata.sessionID`; `input.sessionID` means "continue an existing child" (`mode: continue`, else `spawn`). Harness comes from the child's `model.providerID` (`devin-native` -> devin, `antigravity-native` -> antigravity, else opencode); `hivemind-delegate` may also carry `input.harness`.
- Durable foreign session bindings (`foreignSessionID`, `turn`, `phase`, `foreignAck`, `consumedInputs`, `servingWitness`) live in `opencode.db` table `kv` under `plugin:<utf16be-hex>:bindings/<childSessionID>` and `delegate-mode/child/<childSessionID>`.
- Message types in `@opencode/schema`: `user`, `assistant`, `skill`, `shell`, `synthetic`, `system`, `compaction`, `idle`, `agent-switched`, `model-switched`, `location-switched`.
- `Assistant.snapshot` (`start`/`end`) are Git `tree` SHAs in OpenCode's shadow bare repo (`~/.local/share/opencode/snapshot/<project_id>/<sha1(directory)>/`), not project `.git` commits.
- `ctx.session.hook("context", ...)` runs synchronously on the critical path of every primary LLM step and must remain strictly in-memory (`< 2 ms`).
- Changes under `.opencode/` trigger a host hot-reload - the archive therefore lives in `<canonicalRoot>/.session-archive/`, never under `.opencode/`.
- Every record carries `raw_ref: {session_id, message_id, seq}` back to `opencode.db`.

## Agent Surface (`hivemind-substrate`)

- **Auto signal (0 calls):** On `idle`, `context` hook injects `[substrate] dirty|commit <id> ... trace({change:"<id>"})` once per change-set.
- **Call 1 - Package (`<= 800` tok):** `substrate.viewport({ action: "trace", change?: "<id>", commit?: "<sha>" })` -> ranked branches (`source`, `test`, `config`, `docs`, `owner`, `evidence`, `actors`, `pre-existing`, `noise`, `blocked`, `worktrees`, `related`, `history`) with `<id>:<branch>` handles.
- **Call 2 - Leaf:** `substrate.viewport({ action: "trace", handle: "<id>:<branch>", path?: "<relPath|ses_id>" })` -> file SHA-256 attribution proof + unified diff (`source`/`test`/`config`), subagent touched files + checks + conclusion (`actors`), or test/build check staleness (`evidence`).
- **Codebase & Recall (`substrate.viewport`):** `repomap` | `skeleton` (`path`) | `slice` (`path`, `symbol`) | `coupled` (`path`) | `brief` (`targetPaths`, `symbolNames`) | `search` (`query`) | `resolve` (`blob`, `startLine`, `endLine`) | `provenance` | `timeline` | `compaction` | `sync`.
- **Working-Set Valve (`substrate.valve`):** `prune` | `status` | `reset` (`mode`, `keepRecentSteps`) + `FRESH | SLICE | STALE` manifest.

## Commands

```sh
bun test              # all unit + e2e tests (fixture DBs, no host needed)
bun run typecheck     # tsc --noEmit
bun run build         # bundles src/plugin.ts -> dist/session-archive.ts
ARCHIVE_REAL_DB=1 bun test test/realdb.test.ts   # opt-in drive on the real host DB
```

## Rules

- Commit only when authorized by the owner using `atomic-git-commit`.
- Never write to `opencode.db` or `~/.local/share/opencode/snapshot/` - read-only sources only.
- Fixture DDL must be re-synced when the pinned host version moves; drift is a loud error, not a silent skip.

# hivemind-session-archive

An OpenCode V2 plugin that persists the current session tree — the root
session plus every descendant child session (subagents, `delegate-devin`,
`hivemind-delegate`) — into a deterministic, project-scoped transcript
archive.

It exists so reflective/agent tooling (`reflect`, `recall`,
`show-me-your-work`, `interrogate`, review and audit workflows) has stable,
queryable transcripts instead of manual `session export` JSON snapshots.

- **Source of truth:** reads `opencode.db` read-only through `bun:sqlite`.
  It never writes to the host database.
- **Deterministic:** no wall-clock output, stable key order, temp-file +
  rename writes. A second persist of unchanged sessions writes nothing.
- **Explicit-only:** it runs only when the user or agent invokes
  `archive_persist`. Nothing is archived automatically.

## Install (agent instructions)

You are an agent inside OpenCode. To make `archive_persist` available in the
end-user's current project, pick one:

### Option A — config entry (recommended)

Add a plugin entry to the project's `opencode.json`, preserving any existing
keys:

```jsonc
{
  "plugins": [
    { "package": "hivemind-session-archive" }
  ]
}
```

Or run the installer, which makes exactly this edit and is idempotent:

```sh
npx hivemind-session-archive            # project scope: ./opencode.json
npx hivemind-session-archive --global   # global: ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json
npx hivemind-session-archive --check    # report status, no writes
```

Tell the user to reload OpenCode (or restart the TUI). Changes under
`.opencode/` hot-reload; `opencode.json` edits may need a restart.

### Option B — drop-in file

Copy the bundled single-file build from the package into the project's
plugin directory:

```sh
mkdir -p .opencode/plugins
cp node_modules/hivemind-session-archive/dist/session-archive.ts .opencode/plugins/
```

The file is bundled JavaScript saved with a `.ts` extension and carries a
`// @ts-nocheck` header; this is intentional — it must stay dependency-free.

Then reload OpenCode.

## Use

After reload the agent has the `archive_persist` tool (namespace `archive`,
Code Mode by default). Call it — or answer a user request like "persist /
archive this session" — with no arguments to archive the current session
tree:

```
archive_persist({})            // current session's whole tree
archive_persist({ sessionID }) // tree containing a specific session
```

The tool returns a report: `rootID`, `archiveDir`, counts of sessions /
messages / delegations, `written[]` files and `unchanged` count.

### Plugin options

Set under the plugin entry's `options` in `opencode.json`:

```jsonc
{ "package": "hivemind-session-archive",
  "options": { "dir": ".session-archive", "dbPath": "…", "direct": false } }
```

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `dir` | `.session-archive` | Archive directory, relative to the canonical project root. |
| `dbPath` | `~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db` (XDG-aware) | Host DB to read. |
| `direct` | `false` | `true` registers the tool outside Code Mode. |

## What it writes

Under `<canonicalRoot>/.session-archive/`:

```
sessions/<root>/<root>.jsonl            # header + normalized records
sessions/<root>/info.json               # session header, pretty-printed
sessions/<root>/subagents/<child>/…     # child trees, nested recursively
blobs/<sha256>.txt                      # reasoning text, oversized tool I/O,
                                        # file/skill bodies — deduplicated
index.sqlite                            # queryable index: session, delegation,
                                        # message, tool_call, compaction,
                                        # instruction
```

Record notes:

- Every record carries `raw_ref: {session_id, message_id, seq}` pointing back
  to `opencode.db`.
- Reasoning text lives in blobs; encrypted reasoning keeps only a byte count.
- Strings over 4096 chars in tool inputs/outputs become `blob:<sha256>`
  references with a preview.
- One `delegation` edge covers `subagent`, `delegate-devin` and
  `hivemind-delegate`, distinguished by a `harness` column
  (`devin | antigravity | opencode`) and `mode` (`spawn | continue`).
- Sessions run in worktrees or sibling checkouts are classified into `lane`
  (`root | nested | external`) and archived under the canonical project root.

## Requirements

- OpenCode V2 host (plugins run on Bun; `bun:sqlite` must be available).
- A readable `opencode.db` — normally `~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db`.
  If the host schema has drifted, persist fails loudly with
  `session-archive: host schema drift: <table>.<column> missing`.

## Notes for maintainers

```sh
bun test                    # fixture-DB unit + e2e tests
bun run typecheck           # tsc --noEmit
bun run build               # emits dist/session-archive.ts
ARCHIVE_REAL_DB=1 bun test test/realdb.test.ts   # opt-in drive on the live host DB
```

The archive directory (`<project>/.session-archive/`) is a local artifact —
projects decide themselves whether to gitignore or commit it. Treat it as
sensitive: transcripts can contain secrets pasted into a session.

# Glossary

Canonical domain terms for `hivemind-substrate`. Read before naming types, tables, tools, or documents.

## Memory Boundaries & The Box of Context

- **Box of Context:** The finite linear token buffer sent to the model on a single request, partitioned into System Invariants, Ambient Topological Map, Active Task & Dialogue, and JIT Snippets.
- **Active Context:** The outgoing `event.messages` and `event.system` payload assembled by OpenCode for the current LLM step (`ctx.session.hook("context", ...)`).
- **Persisted Record:** Raw rows and files written by the host or harness (`~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db`, `~/.local/share/opencode/tool-output/`, `~/.local/share/opencode/shell/`, `~/.local/share/opencode/snapshot/`).
- **Retrievable Memory:** Structured, content-addressed records in `.session-archive/` (`index.sqlite`, `blobs/<sha256>.txt`, and session JSONL transcripts) queryable by deterministic tools across sessions and compactions.
- **Continuation State:** Harness-owned session binding and checkpoint state required to resume execution on the original foreign trajectory (`devin`, `antigravity`, or `opencode`). Distinct from Retrievable Memory.

## The Three-Layer Substrate

- **The Spine:** Layer 1 append-only physical ground truth (`.session-archive/blobs/<sha256>.txt`, JSONL transcripts, OpenCode shadow worktree Git trees, repository `.git` commit history, and raw workspace files). Never dumped raw into Active Context.
- **The Honeycomb:** Layer 2 queryable relational and structural graph index in `.session-archive/index.sqlite` (sessions, delegations, trajectory milestones, user prompts, tool calls, file touches, snapshot artifacts, AST code skeletons, PageRank scores, and Git temporal co-change probabilities).
- **Artifacts & Viewports:** Layer 3 role-specific, token-budgeted projections synthesized from The Honeycomb and The Spine (Strategist Viewport, Implementor Viewport, Working-Memory Manifest, and Compaction Continuity Ledger).

## Trajectory, Delegation & Provenance

- **Semantic Session Digest:** The materialised natural-language identity card for a session tree (`session_semantic_digest`), indexing the initial goal, latest intent summary, active phase/ticket/gate, touched file paths, loaded skills, child harness summary, and verification status so agents can locate sessions by meaning via FTS5 BM25 rather than opaque `ses_...` IDs.
- **Intent Pivot:** A classified human message along a session trajectory (`intent_pivot`), categorized into `initial_goal | course_correction | approval | handoff_resume | prune_or_continuity | followup | verification_directive | scope_narrowing | continuation_after_compaction` and linked to its lossless `blob:<sha256>` prompt text.
- **Delegation Turn:** A single parent-to-child stop interval keyed by `(parent_session_id, call_id, turn_index)` (`delegation_turn`), preserving every `spawn` and subsequent `send`/`continue` turn on a continuing child trajectory without overwriting prior turns.
- **Trajectory Milestone:** A discrete stopped turn (`idle`), user redirect, delegation handoff, or compaction checkpoint along a continuing parent or child session, linking the prompt/instruction, assistant response, tool calls, `StepSnapshot` tree SHAs, `ReportedOutcome`, and `VerifiedOutcome`.
- **Snapshot Artifact:** A working-tree file draft extracted from OpenCode's shadow Git bare repository (`start_tree:path` or `end_tree:path`) and persisted to `.session-archive/blobs/<sha256>.txt` (`snapshot_artifact`), preserving uncommitted child and parent edits across `git gc`.
- **Spill Artifact:** An untruncated tool or shell output file captured from `~/.local/share/opencode/tool-output/` or `~/.local/share/opencode/shell/` and sunk into `.session-archive/blobs/<sha256>.txt` (`spill_artifact`) before the host's 7-day retention sweep.
- **Provenance Chain:** The verifiable causal graph connecting `AuditFinding -> DecisionOrRedirect -> ProposedRepair -> FileTouch/Commit -> VerificationReceipt`.
- **Step Snapshot:** The pair of shadow Git tree SHAs (`start_tree`, `end_tree`) captured by OpenCode in `~/.local/share/opencode/snapshot/<project_id>/<sha1(directory)>/` before and after an assistant step, enabling point-in-time recovery of uncommitted file drafts.
- **Reported Outcome:** What a child session or assistant message claims in prose or host idle status (`idle_outcome = "succeeded"`), which may diverge from actual tool/test execution (`semantic_status` and `verified_status`).
- **Verified Outcome:** Deterministic `verification_receipt` proof anchored to an executed command, exit code, output `blob:<sha256>`, Git `head_sha`, and `worktree_tree_sha`, automatically downgraded to `verified_stale_by_later_touch` if a covered path is edited later without a newer passing receipt.

## Working-Set Valve & Viewports

- **Assistant Step Watermark:** The pruning boundary anchored to the `N`-th most recent `assistant` message ID (`anchorMessageID`, `keepRecentSteps`) rather than `role === "user"`, enabling mid-turn pruning during long single-prompt autonomous runs.
- **Fact Breadcrumb:** The compact replacement stub injected by the `context` hook for thinned tool calls and outputs, preserving tool name, target path/line range, character count, and content-addressed `blob:<sha256>` handle.
- **Working-Memory Manifest:** The compact "Do-Not-Reread" ledger summarizing files already read (with line ranges and 3-state disk slice SHA status `FRESH — DO NOT REREAD`, `SLICE L<start>-L<end> of <total> — FRESH SLICE`, or `STALE (modified since read/review — re-verify slice)`), files modified, skills loaded (`ACTIVE — DO NOT RE-INVOKE`), and co-change alerts.
- **File Read Slice (`FileReadCapture`):** The normalized representation of an OpenCode `read` tool execution (`path`, `start_line`, `end_line`, `total_lines`, `is_truncated`, `line_range`, raw `blob_sha`, and line-slice `slice_sha`), separating the raw tool-output archive blob from the stripped file-content slice hash used for staleness reconciliation.
- **JIT Read Skeleton Footer:** The structural zoom-out footer appended via `ctx.tool.hook("execute.after", ...)` when a host `read` tool call is truncated or spans a large unindexed file, surfacing the file's Tier-2 `AstSkeleton` symbol spans (`[Lstart-Lend]`) and Tier-4 `CoChangeCoupling` hints so the agent requests targeted symbol slices (`substrate.viewport({ action: "slice", path, symbol })`) rather than re-reading raw 2,000-line blocks.
- **Substrate Inspector Panel & Full-Screen Route:** The native OpenCode V2 TUI package surface (`tui.tsx` via `@opencode/plugin/tui` and `@opentui/solid`, loaded from a plugin package directory) exposing the 100% full-screen route (`context.ui.router.register({ name: "substrate" })`), split panel (`session.panel`), sidebar (`sidebar.content`), footer pill (`prompt.footer.status`), `/substrate` slash command, and `SubstrateRpc` client bindings.
- **Mudball & Architecture Advisor:** The human-and-agent structural health projection combining PageRank `RepoMap` hubs, selectable file `AstSkeleton` symbol outlines, `Hidden Coupling` warnings (`git_cochange` pairs with `has_static_edge = 0`), complexity hotspots (oversized files, high fan-in/fan-out hubs, god functions `>= 150` lines), and live token-compression savings.
- **One-Truth File Provenance State:** The unified SQLite-backed per-file freshness model shared by `WorkingSetValve` and `ProvenanceChain` (`1` active truth row per file path, `slice_sha` for partial slices `L<start>-L<end> of <total>`, raw disk SHA for full-file reads `L1-L<total>`, and zero non-file `"session"` pseudo-chains).
- **Compaction Continuation Packet:** The deterministic `< 1,200`-token post-compaction brief synthesized from `index.sqlite` (`compaction_continuation_ledger`), previewable via `substrate.viewport({ action: "compaction" })` and injected via `ctx.session.hook("compaction", ...)`, uniting the session headline, chronological `IntentPivot` timeline, `WorkingMemoryManifest`, multi-turn `DelegationTurn` table, `ProvenanceChain` staleness status, and Tier-1 `RepoMap`.
- **Strategist Viewport:** The Orchestrator-focused projection emphasizing user intent sequence, child delegation milestones, provenance chains, and verification gate status (`< 600` ambient tokens).
- **Implementor Viewport:** The Specialist-focused projection emphasizing 4-tier progressive disclosure over codebase structure (`RepoMap`, `AstSkeleton`, `SymbolSlice`, `CoChangeCoupling`) across the active project, worktrees, or sibling repositories.
- **AST Code Skeleton:** A deterministic syntax outline of a source file (`Bun.Transpiler.scan` + Depth-2 closure-factory descent) defaulting to exported declarations and Depth-2 class/factory members with `<= 120`-character signature caps and single `[Lstart-Lend]` anchors (`includePrivate: true` opt-in for non-exported helpers).
- **Temporal Co-Change Coupling:** The conditional probability $P(F_A \mid F_B) = \frac{\text{Commits}(F_A \cap F_B)}{\text{Commits}(F_B)}$ that file $F_A$ is modified in the same commit as $F_B$, mined from repository `git log` history after filtering out bulk commits on total commit file count.
